message.content: Upon the arrival of the *Pharaon* in Marseilles on February 24, 1815, following the death of its captain, the young first mate Edmond Dantès is greeted by his owner Morrel, who expresses confidence in Dantès's capabilities and hints at promoting him to captain, while the jealous supercargo Danglars secretly plots against him by revealing his unauthorized stop at Elba to deliver a letter to the exiled Emperor Napoleon.
